name: Ca hanh
summary: Cá hanh is a brackish fish from phá Tam Giang and đầm Cầu Hai, sold at chợ Cầu Hai. It comes in with the lagoon’s brackish scent and the salt of the sea mouths.
origin: Chợ Cầu Hai. Cá hanh is caught in phá Tam Giang and đầm Cầu Hai.
taste: The fish comes in still brackish, with the salt of the sea mouths.
howToEat: Buy it at the market and cook it later. People buy the fish for the weekend.
where: Chợ Cầu Hai, on National Highway 1A, about 40 km south of Huế, facing the lagoon.
seoTitle: Ca hanh at Cau Hai market
seoDescription: Cá hanh is a brackish lagoon fish sold at chợ Cầu Hai.
